retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant ensemble portrait featuring a group in red graduation regalia against a solid cyan backdrop with bold, overlapping geometric typography.
excludeWhen: dark or moody lighting is required
minimalist or high-fashion aesthetic is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A bright, high-key group photograph of young adults in red graduation caps and gowns, arranged in two tiers against a flat cyan background, featuring a large central typographic logo with a thick white outline.
coreVisualRelationships: Red regalia contrasting against a solid cyan background
Large-scale central typography overlapping the subjects
Tiered arrangement of subjects creating a full frame
Dynamic element of a tossed mortarboard in the upper corner
coreInvariants: Uniform red graduation gowns and caps
Lower-case sans-serif typography for primary titles

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Ensemble cast fills the lower two-thirds of the frame in a tiered, overlapping arrangement.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white-outlined red text in the upper center acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large central logo, move down to the faces of the cast, and finally to the yellow text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily in the upper corners around the tossed cap.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation and high value across all primary colors for a pop-art feel.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight tracking causing characters to touch or overlap
Thick white outer stroke on primary title
Consistent lowercase usage for all elements
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'l' and 'e' in the main title are merged or tightly tucked into the 'g'
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Uniform typeface family used across different weights and colors for brand consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Geometric circular forms and tight kerning potential
Strong geometric foundation and lowercase aesthetic

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group of diverse young adults in red graduation gowns and caps against a solid cyan background. Arrange them in two rows, with one person on the left reaching up as if they just threw a cap. Leave the top center area clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large lowercase geometric sans-serif text in the top center with a red fill and thick white outline. Add a secondary line of yellow lowercase text across the bottom foreground.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid cyan?
Are all subjects wearing red graduation regalia?
Is the primary text lowercase with a thick white outline?
Is the tracking tight enough that letters nearly touch?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the ensemble

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on all graphic elements
Even, bright lighting on all faces
High color contrast between red and cyan

postGenerationChecks: Check that the white outline on the main text is consistent
Ensure the yellow text at the bottom is legible against the red gowns
Verify the tossed cap is in the upper left quadrant
recipe.reuseFormula: Ensemble cast in [Color A] regalia + [Color B] solid background + [Color A] outlined lowercase title + [Color C] footer text.
